findings.evidence: src/app/logout/route.ts defines a dedicated GET handler that redirects to /api/auth/signout, and src/app/plans/page.tsx renders an explicit "Logout" link (href="/api/auth/signout?callbackUrl=/login"). This is a distinct, input-evident user-facing action (mirroring UC-002 Log in) but has no corresponding use case in the document, which only covers UC-001 through UC-006 (register, login, create plan, add item, export CSV, delete plan).
findings.message: No use case documents the logout flow, even though src/app/logout/route.ts and the "Logout" link in src/app/plans/page.tsx implement a distinct, user-facing logout action analogous to UC-002 (login).
